items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Sarah Vaughan, George Treadwell, Dexter Gordon, we all went by there and had dinner, you know?

ctx.x: He was a very brilliant man, wasn't he?

Yes, he was. I had dinner at his house in Kansas City once. We were doing Jazz at the Philharmonic, and I met his mother, and his mother was like a typical mother. You know, her son could do no wrong. And she fixed -- oh, boy, she fixed a great meal for us. Sarah Vaughan, George Treadwell, Dexter Gordon, we all went by there and had dinner, you know?
